verdict.rationale: Windmill vendor-hosts a Scalar API Reference at app.windmill.dev/openapi.html. It renders the live OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, and Scalar's built-in request client lets users run calls from the page. The probe 404s on www.windmill.dev paths don't contradict this, because the spec is served from the app.windmill.dev host. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent confirmation that the try-it client works against the API, documented curated runnable code examples beyond the generic request client, and a guarantee the deployed spec isn't trailing the source release.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
